title: 鐵路路基過渡段處理~Railway subgrade transition treatment
focus: 剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同~Stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement
summary: 鐵路路基過渡段處理以「剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。路基過渡段把柔性土工支承連到較硬的橋台或涵洞，幾何高差與剛度突變會互相放大，單次起道不能消除深層沉陷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A transition connects flexible earth support to a stiffer abutment or culvert; level differences and stiffness jumps can amplify one another, and a single lifting correction cannot remove deep settlement. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把鐵路路基過渡段處理放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。路基過渡段把柔性土工支承連到較硬的橋台或涵洞，幾何高差與剛度突變會互相放大，單次起道不能消除深層沉陷。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Railway subgrade transition treatment in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. A transition connects flexible earth support to a stiffer abutment or culvert; level differences and stiffness jumps can amplify one another, and a single lifting correction cannot remove deep settlement. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.1 mm。模型邊界：兩個獨立線性支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm；y=khard/ksoft=4 1。只把 khard 增加百分之十，y=4.4 1。模型邊界：相同載重區間的等效剛度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm; y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.1 mm. Boundary: Two independent linear supports; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm; y=khard/ksoft=4 1. Increasing only khard with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.4 1. Boundary: Equivalent stiffness over the same load interval; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 相鄰支承位移差~Adjacent-support displacement difference
units.title: 相鄰支承位移差~Adjacent-support displacement difference
units.mechanism: 同載重下不同支承剛度造成位移差。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.1 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩個獨立線性支承。使用兩側同步載重位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部懸空使差異增加，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Different support stiffnesses create displacement differences under equal load. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.1 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Two independent linear supports. Use simultaneous load-displacement on both sides as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.1 mm。模型邊界：兩個獨立線性支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm; y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.1 mm. Boundary: Two independent linear supports; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以兩側同步載重位移區分模型與觀察，先用荷重元及雙位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「相鄰支承位移差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use simultaneous load-displacement on both sides to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using load cells and paired displacement gauges, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Adjacent-support displacement difference. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 局部懸空使差異增加。這個失效與「相鄰支承位移差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查兩側同步載重位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch. This failure and a measurement bias in Adjacent-support displacement difference can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check simultaneous load-displacement on both sides rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部懸空使差異增加~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch.
units.practice: 重算「相鄰支承位移差」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩個獨立線性支承如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部懸空使差異增加造成偏離的合成觀察，以兩側同步載重位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Adjacent-support displacement difference, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Two independent linear supports. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch. Explain which evidence in simultaneous load-displacement on both sides distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 剛度比值辨認~Stiffness-ratio identification
units.mechanism: 剛度比描述突變程度但不含過渡長度。本模型把 khard 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 4.4 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。相同載重區間的等效剛度。使用沿程剛度剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；同比值不同長度可有不同動態效應，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Stiffness ratio describes contrast but excludes transition length. In this model, khard is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 4.4 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Equivalent stiffness over the same load interval. Use longitudinal stiffness profile as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equal ratios over different lengths have different dynamics; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm；y=khard/ksoft=4 1。只把 khard 增加百分之十，y=4.4 1。模型邊界：相同載重區間的等效剛度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm; y=khard/ksoft=4 1. Increasing only khard with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.4 1. Boundary: Equivalent stiffness over the same load interval; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以沿程剛度剖面區分模型與觀察，先用定載撓度測試建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「剛度比值辨認」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use longitudinal stiffness profile to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using constant-load deflection tests, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Stiffness-ratio identification. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 同比值不同長度可有不同動態效應。這個失效與「剛度比值辨認」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查沿程剛度剖面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Equal ratios over different lengths have different dynamics. This failure and a measurement bias in Stiffness-ratio identification can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check longitudinal stiffness profile rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「剛度比值辨認」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出相同載重區間的等效剛度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由同比值不同長度可有不同動態效應造成偏離的合成觀察，以沿程剛度剖面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Stiffness-ratio identification, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Equivalent stiffness over the same load interval. units.title: 剛度漸變斜率~Stiffness-gradient slope
units.mechanism: 將剛度差分散到較長距離降低平均斜率。本模型把 k1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 1.9 kN/mm/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。假定線性漸變。使用各里程支承剛度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部突跳可被平均斜率掩蓋，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Spreading stiffness contrast over longer distance reduces its mean gradient. In this model, k1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 1.9 kN/mm/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Assumed linear grading. Use support stiffness at each chainage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A local jump can hide within the mean slope; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k1=20 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm, L=20 m；y=(k2-k1)/L=2 kN/mm/m。只把 k1 增加百分之十，y=1.9 kN/mm/m。模型邊界：假定線性漸變；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: k1=20 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm, L=20 m; y=(k2-k1)/L=2 kN/mm/m. Increasing only k1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.9 kN/mm/m. Boundary: Assumed linear grading; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以各里程支承剛度區分模型與觀察，先用分段荷載位移量測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「剛度漸變斜率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use support stiffness at each chainage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using segmented load-displacement measurements, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Stiffness-gradient slope. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 局部突跳可被平均斜率掩蓋。這個失效與「剛度漸變斜率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各里程支承剛度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~A local jump can hide within the mean slope. This failure and a measurement bias in Stiffness-gradient slope can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check support stiffness at each chainage rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.title: 差異沉陷坡度~Differential-settlement slope
units.mechanism: 相同沉陷差在短距離形成更陡幾何變化。本模型把 ds 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.88 mm/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。小坡度兩點近似。使用時序高程剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；基準下沉會混淆真實沉陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Equal settlement contrast creates steeper geometry over shorter distance. In this model, ds is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.88 mm/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Small-slope two-point approximation. Use time-series elevation profiles as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Datum movement confounds actual settlement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：ds=12 mm, L=15 m；y=ds/L=0.8 mm/m。只把 ds 增加百分之十，y=0.88 mm/m。模型邊界：小坡度兩點近似；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: ds=12 mm, L=15 m; y=ds/L=0.8 mm/m. units.anchor: 填土壓縮量級~Fill compression scale
units.title: 填土壓縮量級~Fill compression scale
units.mechanism: 壓縮模數把應力增量連到層厚變化。本模型把 stress 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13.2 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。一維均勻壓縮。使用應力與分層位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Constrained modulus links stress increase to thickness change. units.verify: 本單元以已用與預留調整量區分模型與觀察，先用竣工調整紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「調整剩餘空間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use used and reserved adjustment to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using as-built adjustment records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Remaining adjustment range. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍。這個失效與「調整剩餘空間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已用與預留調整量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. This failure and a measurement bias in Remaining adjustment range can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check used and reserved adjustment rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range.
units.practice: 重算「調整剩餘空間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出同方向代數餘量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍造成偏離的合成觀察，以已用與預留調整量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Remaining adjustment range, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Algebraic reserve in one direction. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. Explain which evidence in used and reserved adjustment distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
